{{Quote|There ''is'' a known Mandalorian supply outpost in this system.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three" />}}
'''Vizsla Keep 09''',<ref name="Vizsla Keep 09" /> also referred to as the '''Mandalorian asteroid outpost''',<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Four">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref> was a supply outpost<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three" /> operated in the rings of [[Phelbos]]<ref name="Vizsla Keep 09" /> in the [[Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="Location note" /> during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Maul]], leader of [[Death Watch]], took [[Count]] [[Dooku]] and [[General]] [[Grievous]] to the outpost after capturing them during a [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] on Ord Mantell. The [[Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Republic]] tracked Maul and his [[Shadow Collective]] to the outpost, leading to an [[Assault on Vizsla Keep 09|assault]] against Maul's forces.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:MaulGauntletFighter-SWZ.png|thumb|left|250px|Maul departs from Vizsla Keep 09 in the ''Nightbrother''.]]
During the [[Clone Wars]], [[Death Watch]] commander [[Pre Vizsla]] built the keep as one of the many [[Mandalorian]] bases around [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Vizsla Keep 09" /> Following Vizsla's [[death]] at the hands of former [[Sith]] [[Sith Lord|Lord]] [[Maul]],<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref> the [[Shadow Collective]] and Maul learned of it and took control of the keep.<ref name="Vizsla Keep 09" /> Following the [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] on [[Ord Mantell]], Maul went to the Keep. There, he contacted his old [[Sith Master|master]], [[Darth Sidious]] and informed him of [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s and [[General]] [[Grievous]]'s capture.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three" />

The [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic|forces]] under [[Jedi]] [[Jedi General|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Mace Windu]], [[Aayla Secura]], and [[Tiplee]] then [[Assault on Vizsla Keep 09|attacked]] the outpost. There, they fought against Maul's forces, Dooku, and General Grievous until Dooku killed Tiplee. The Jedi were then knocked out by [[Rook Kast]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Three" /> Maul's forces were then forced to abandon it.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Four" />

===Age of the Empire===
[[File:Rings_of_Phelbos.png|thumb|right|250px|Kanan Jarrus and Ezra Bridger arrive at Vizsla Keep 09.]]
In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must take place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "[[The Holocrons of Fate]]" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," the events of the episode must also take place in 2 BBY.</ref> Maul had [[Maul's capture of the Ghost crew|captured]] the ''[[Ghost]]'s'' [[Spectres|crew]] and brought them to the keep. Once there, Maul waited for [[Jedi Knight]] [[Kanan Jarrus]] and his [[Padawan|apprentice]] [[Ezra Bridger]] to arrive with the [[Sith holocron|Sith]] [[Sith holocron (Malachor)|holocron]]. There, Maul had his [[RIC-1200|droids]] take Ezra to the command center.<ref name="Holocrons of Fate">{{Rebels|The Holocrons of Fate}}</ref>

Maul then led Kanan to a [[airlock]] and pushed him into [[Realspace|space]]. Kanan was able to use [[the Force]] to pull himself back to the Keep. He was then able to free his friends from Maul's [[droid]]s. In the command center, Maul and Ezra then opened both the Sith [[holocron]] and [[Kanan Jarrus' holocron|Kanan's holocron]]. Together, they then [[Holocron fusion|combined]] the holocrons.<ref name="Holocrons of Fate" />
